# Custom allowlist for the Copilot cloud agent's firewall
# (repo Settings -> Copilot -> Internet access -> Copilot cloud agent ->
# Custom allowlist). Settings don't sync from this file -- it's the source
# of truth you copy from. One domain per line; an entry is assumed to cover
# its subdomains (schoolspring.com covers crook1.schoolspring.com).
#
# test-copilot-allowlist.R fails when a host the scrapers hit isn't covered
# here -- a k12_district_registry.csv Job_Link, a misc_district_registry
# url, a he_institution_urls page, or a URL hardcoded in a scraper file or
# Wy_ED_Jobs.Rmd. So adding a district means adding its domain here AND in
# the repo settings, or the agent can't fetch that page to fix it.
applitrack.com
cheyenneclassical.org
eeik.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com
governmentjobs.com
growingluskleaders.org
guernseysunrise.org
lcsd2.org
paylocity.com
pcsd16.com
peopleadmin.com
platte1.org
prairieviewschool.org
redroverk12.com
schooljobs.com
schoolspring.com
sheridan.edu
sheridan3.com
simplehire.com
sites.google.com
sub1.org
tedk12.com
uinta4.com
uwyo.edu
wcsd1.org
weston7.org
wsba-wy.org
wsh2.k12.wy.us
wyoclassical.org

# Render-time asset hosts: not job-board URLs, but chromote needs them for
# the page to hydrate. Without Apptegy's CDNs the agent's headless Chrome
# gets an empty shell, so innerText shows no postings (found on the Montana
# dashboard's first auto-fix, 2026-09-30). test-copilot-allowlist.R checks
# these per platform.
5il.co
apptegy.net
